shortlist.label: Autoimmune hemolytic anemia
shortlist.why_kept: Positive direct antiglobulin test for IgG and clinical presentation of anemia and jaundice

shortlist.label: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia-associated hemolytic anemia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of chronic lymphocytic leukemia and is presenting with signs of hemolytic anemia

shortlist.label: Warm antibody hemolytic anemia
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation and laboratory results consistent with warm antibody hemolytic anemia

shortlist.label: Evans syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has autoimmune hemolytic anemia and may also have immune thrombocytopenia, which is a component of Evans syndrome

shortlist.label: Mixed warm and cold autoimmune hemolytic anemia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's laboratory results and clinical presentation could be consistent with a mixed warm and cold autoimmune hemolytic anemia

raw.rationale: The patient has a positive direct antiglobulin test for IgG, low haptoglobin, high lactate dehydrogenase, and reticulocytosis, which are all indicative of autoimmune hemolytic anemia. The presence of conjunctival pallor and scleral icterus also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia-associated hemolytic anemia
rejected.why: While the patient has chronic lymphocytic leukemia, the positive DAT for IgG and other laboratory findings are more specific for autoimmune hemolytic anemia

rejected.label: Warm antibody hemolytic anemia
rejected.why: This is a subtype of autoimmune hemolytic anemia, and the patient's presentation is consistent with this, but the more general term autoimmune hemolytic anemia is preferred

rejected.label: Evans syndrome
rejected.why: This syndrome involves both autoimmune hemolytic anemia and immune thrombocytopenia, but there is no mention of thrombocytopenia in the patient's presentation

rejected.label: Mixed warm and cold autoimmune hemolytic anemia
rejected.why: There is no evidence of cold antibodies (C3d was negative), making this diagnosis less likely
